|lore=Scoundrel and gambler. Petty administrator of a small Tibanna gas mining operation. Easily coerced. Has problems of his own. Had dealings with the Tonnika Sisters – twice.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, if at a battleground, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from any just drawn destiny. Once per turn, may take A Real Hero into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The remaster reduces power from 5 to 3 and forfeit from 7 to 4. The contemporary issuer full image and slip both retain the broad just-drawn destiny adjustment and A Real Hero pull, with the same deploy, ability and Pilot/Warrior icons. Legacy Block 2 prints the later narrower adjustment without A Real Hero. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071127053958id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v6/ds/landocalrissian.gif Set 6 Players Committee full image, captured 27 November 2007]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=2 Separate Legacy Block 2 #14E]. The display uses a reconstruction matching the exact Set 6 issuer face. The previously associated Holotable image represents the later Legacy wording. [[:File:Holotable-OVS6-Lando-Calrissian-v17.gif|retained image file]].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards6.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #32 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 42. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Lando Calrissian (Dark)]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds#Cards|Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
* Earlier versions: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf final revised sheet of 12 January 2004] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf revised sheet of 12 October 2004] (old pre-Remaster slips).
|hatnote=This is the current (Remaster) text of this Virtual Original card. For the earliest surviving (January 2004) slip, see [[Lando Calrissian (V) (Virtual Set 6)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Lando Calrissian (Dark)]].
